item.title: Casual Talking Camera Testimonial

exact_text: FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.

turns.text: Make an 8-second vertical testimonial-style ad for FitTrack. A fictional woman in her 30s, filming herself at home, talks to camera: “FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.” Friendly and casual, with matching captions. Use a made-up presenter, not a real customer.

item.tests: Checks delivery of a short scripted talking-camera ad with audible speech and accurate captions, rather than a silent portrait or unrelated montage.

answer_sheet.Platform and size: Vertical 9:16 for a social reel; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Presenter: A fictional woman in her thirties, filming herself at home; not a real customer.
answer_sheet.Script and captions: FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.
answer_sheet.Language, voice and mood: English, friendly and casual; specific accent is your call.

must_haves: One approximately 8-second vertical video shows a fictional adult woman addressing the camera in a home setting.
The complete supplied script is audible in English without omissions or added testimonial claims.
Readable captions reproduce the supplied script exactly and follow the speech.
The presenter visibly speaks rather than remaining a still image throughout.
The ad does not label the fictional presenter as a verified or real customer.

turns.text: Make an 8-second vertical testimonial-style ad for FitTrack. A fictional woman in her 30s, filming herself at home, talks to camera: “FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.” Friendly and casual, with matching captions. Use a made-up presenter, not a real customer.

dialog.agent:
I can use a fictional presenter and label the ad “AI-generated presenter — dramatization,” with matching captions.

There’s one blocker: the connected Free account’s spoken-ad tool is limited to **5 seconds unless a credit pack has been purchased**, so I can’t submit the requested 8-second version with the current settings. Commercial use also requires a paid plan, credit pack, or paid usage arrangement.

Would you prefer to **enable paid access for the exact 8-second ad**, or shorten it to a 5-second preview with a shorter script?
dialog.why: It asks the user to choose between enabling paid access for the 8-second ad or shortening it to a 5-second preview, and waits for their choice.
dialog.user: Yes, go ahead and enable paid access for the exact 8-second ad.

dialog.agent:
I can’t change your plan or purchase credits from this chat. Please enable paid access in [Magic Hour](https://magichour.ai/pricing), then let me know once it’s active.

After that, I can create the exact **8-second vertical FitTrack ad** with your script, a fictional woman in her 30s filming at home, matching captions, and an AI-presenter disclosure.
dialog.why: It says it cannot change the plan or purchase credits and requires the user to enable paid access before creating the ad.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

dialog.agent:
The free spoken-ad tool supports only **5 seconds**, so it can’t deliver the exact 8-second ad. Your full script would also be too rushed in that time.

I can make a **5-second vertical preview** with the fictional presenter, matching captions, and an AI-generated disclosure using:

> “FitTrack makes workout planning easy—and helps my routine stick.”

Shall I use this shortened version?
dialog.why: It asks the user to choose whether to use a shortened script for a 5-second preview and waits for their response.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the generation because your account has **insufficient credits**, even for the free settings. No media was created.

Once credits are available, I can make the approved 5-second vertical preview with the fictional presenter, shortened script, matching captions, and AI-presenter disclosure.

style.prompt: Vertical 9:16 realistic smartphone selfie frame for a fictional fitness app ad. An entirely made-up adult woman aged 34, friendly casual approachable expression, wearing a simple modest teal workout t-shirt, filming herself at home in a bright cozy living room, yoga mat in background. Eye-level front-facing smartphone perspective, waist-up medium close-up, natural window light, authentic casual home setting, direct eye contact with camera, realistic anatomy. Leave lower portion uncluttered for captions. Small clear unobtrusive text in top safe area: 'AI presenter • Dramatization'. No other text, no logos, no phone visible.
